summary: Mottainai is a fast, clever card game from the designer of Glory to Rome, where every card can be used as an action, a resource, or a building material depending on how you play it. It rewards tight tactical thinking about how your discarded actions help the next player, creating a tense push-pull rhythm in a very short playtime.
criticised: rules can be confusing to first-time players
iconography-heavy cards are a barrier to entry
some feel it lacks the depth of Glory to Rome

interaction.kind: Follow mechanic: your role choice lets every opponent piggyback on your action
interaction.detail: On your turn you pick an action and every other player may follow it, so your choice directly hands opponents opportunities (or you choose actions specifically to deny them a good follow). Hand and tableau are personal, but the constant follow decisions make what one player does routinely reshape what others can do that same turn.
interaction.said: unknown, but as a Glory to Rome successor it inherits that game's reputation for tight 'read the table' interaction where opponents can follow and profit from your chosen action

scoring.how_you_win: Win by using your cards cleverly as tasks, materials, or completed works so that when the deck runs out, you have the highest total value of built works and sold materials.
scoring.score_note: target is # of Works completed, fewer needed at higher player counts
